evaluation_notes: Synthetic fixture validating the harness, not provider accuracy. Video generated by benchmarks/fixtures/generate.py: 8s black 320x240@15fps, drawtext 'ALPHA' enabled t=0..4s and 'BRAVO' enabled t=4..8s. Expected timestamps are the window midpoints (2.0s and 6.0s) annotated from the generation parameters, never from a model. sha256 of the author's fixture: 927ece1f258d334e3304a808a0392d0e3eceaf598a0ad27ee90c50284bb97a79 (regenerate locally; videos are gitignored).
instructions: Report each distinct text shown on screen as an event. Use type "text_alpha" for the text ALPHA and "text_bravo" for the text BRAVO, with the timestamp in seconds at the middle of the interval where the text is visible.
known_ambiguities: Event identity in the harness is (type, timestamp), so the text content is encoded in the event type; argument-level text differences within the same type are invisible to the metric.
Timestamps are window midpoints; any timestamp inside the 4s window is a defensible reading, which the 1.0s tolerance only partially covers.
